Categories.value: Käsivarsi Wilderness Area|Reisa National Park|Finland-Norway border|Self-published work|Boundary stones in Finland|Boundary stones in Norway|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Border markers in Norway|Finland-Norway boundary stones

ImageDescription.value: Border cairn 307a on the Finland-Norway border between Finland‘s Käsivarsi Wilderness Area in Lapland province and Norway‘s Reisa National Park in Troms og Finnmark province. The border was originally marked in the 1750s. The border marker here dates to 1925 after both countries had become independent. It is a stone cairn, the yellow colour is refreshed regularly by the Norwegian army.

Artist.value: Philipp Reichmuth
